summary:
Implemented a Quick Sheet `Roadside Live Session` inside `#roadside-action-stack`. It lets the iPhone user start a local roadside session, mark Safe Stop / Help Called / Moving Again checkpoints, copy a live update, save the log into existing Garage Notes, or reset the session. Search metadata and smoke coverage were updated, and the service-worker cache is now `ridgeline-console-v358`.

Verified:
- `Invoke-BrowserSmoke.ps1 -Pages @('quick-sheet.html')`
- `Test-InternalLinks.ps1`
- `Invoke-SiteAudit.ps1 -Pages @('quick-sheet.html') -Tag audit-v358-roadside-live-session -SkipScreenshots`
- final `Invoke-BrowserSmoke.ps1 -Pages @('index.html')`

Next safe slice: shared navigation/search real-iPhone review, Garage/Maintenance handoff visibility, or real-iPhone review of the new Quick Sheet live session.

Impact Score: 4/5
Visible Change: Quick Sheet now has a live roadside session panel with checkpoint logging, copy update, and Save Log.
Impact Reason: It makes the iPhone roadside workflow useful during an active incident, not just before or after it.
